Hunter Biden Laptop Meme Coin Crashes 99% in an Hour as Pepeto Presale Shows Why Hype Needs Utility

Rene Peters
September 13, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 6:44
Instaread

The Hunter Biden laptop meme coin just gave the market its fastest lesson of 2026. LAPTOP went live on Base at 8am ET on Wednesday, September 9, hit $190.81 two minutes later per Arkham data reported by Decrypt, and was under $4 before the hour was out.

Today it trades at $0.34 per CoinMarketCap, 99.6% below the $199.51 peak CoinGecko logged on launch day.

So what actually killed it? Hunter Biden blames bots. The chart says something else, and the answer points straight at which meme coins are worth holding this cycle and which are not.

LAPTOP Opened at $0.05, Hit $190, and Lost 98% Before Lunch on Base

The Washington Post reported that the token lost nearly all of its value within minutes of its Wednesday debut, Yahoo Finance added on Thursday that X had suspended the project’s account, and CoinDesk tracked the fully diluted valuation sliding from $144 billion to roughly $4.8 billion within the hour. 

The pool opened at $0.05 per token by the team’s own account, bots cleared it in seconds, and regular buyers walked into a price that was already falling.

Analytics firm Bubblemaps found that about 80% of the wallets that bought LAPTOP lost money, with more than 15,000 addresses in the red. Look closely at why. There was no exchange, no product, and nothing to hold once the joke wore off. Attention was the only thing under the price, and attention is always the first thing to leave.

The Hunter Biden Laptop Meme Coin Had Hype Without Utility, and Pepeto Has Both

Pepeto: The Meme Coin With a Working Exchange Behind the Hype

Which brings us to the meme coin that has held our attention this week. Pepeto has pulled in $10.9 million at $0.0000001894 with a Binance listing expected ahead, and the reason it stands out is not the number, it is the part most people will miss. The hype here sits on top of a product, and the distance from this entry to the projected listing price runs into hundreds of multiples.

PepetoSwap links Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Solana through one bridge that charges nothing to cross, and platform trades carry no fees, so what a buyer puts in is what comes out the other side. A built in scanner grades every listed token for risk before money moves. SolidProof audited the full set of contracts, and the project is run by the cofounder of the original Pepe alongside a senior developer who has taken tokens through Binance listings before. If LAPTOP had even one of those pieces, its chart would look different.

More than $10.9 million is in, and the pace keeps picking up. Set that against LAPTOP, where Yahoo Finance noted one wallet booked a $1.18 million profit while another lost $200,000 and thousands ate smaller losses. Hype without a product is a lottery where the bots hold the winning tickets.

Staking pays 163% APY with daily compounding, and the $0.0000001894 entry closes for good once the Binance listing goes live. Our expectation is simple: the buyers holding this price on listing day are the ones the returns land on, a far better use of the next few weeks than waiting for LAPTOP to find a floor.

Hunter Biden’s Laptop (LAPTOP) Sits at $0.34 With $1 as the Next Bounce Target 

Hunter Biden’s Laptop (LAPTOP) trades at $0.34 per CoinMarketCap, with the $0.30 post-crash low as the floor, the same-day low logged on September 9, as the first level above. Our read: a bounce to $1 is a 194% move, and with $37 million in daily volume still flowing, a squeeze that size is possible.

The only catalyst left is the promised airdrop to wallets that lost money on TRUMP, and the market has already voted on that. With 350 million tokens tradable and most of the 1 billion supply locked for up to 36 months per CoinMarketCap, even a full recovery to $3.70 leaves buyers 98% under the peak. Pepeto at $0.0000001894 with a Binance listing on the way offers presale to listing math a broken meme coin cannot touch.

The Bottom Line

The Hunter Biden laptop meme coin showed the market what pure hype does in 2026: a $144 billion valuation in two minutes, then a 99% fall before most people finished breakfast. A bounce to $1 or even $3.70 is on the table. But the best case from $0.34 still leaves the launch day buyers deep underwater.

Pepeto is playing a different game, and it is the one we expect to pay. It has the meme energy that sent LAPTOP to $190, and it pairs that with a live exchange, a SolidProof audit, 163% APY staking, and a Binance listing approaching, all at $0.0000001894 with $10.9 million already committed. LAPTOP had hype and nothing to catch it on the way down.

Pepeto has hype and a floor built from real tools, which is why the presale entry on the official Pepeto site is the one worth holding into listing day. That price does not survive the listing, and we do not see another setup like it arriving this year.

FAQs

Why did the Hunter Biden laptop meme coin LAPTOP crash 99% right after launch?

LAPTOP crashed because a $144 billion fully diluted valuation sat on top of a $48,000 liquidity pool with no product underneath it. Arkham data reported by Decrypt shows the token hit $190.81 two minutes after its September 9 launch on Base and fell to $3.70 within the hour.

Is Pepeto a safer meme coin buy than the Hunter Biden laptop meme coin?

Pepeto combines meme coin demand with a working zero fee exchange, a cross chain bridge, a token scanner, and a SolidProof audit, which gives holders a reason to stay after the hype fades. The presale has raised $10.9 million at $0.0000001894 with 163% APY staking, while LAPTOP trades 99.6% below its peak with no utility behind it.
